semantics: Planned logical exchanges. Solid, dotted and dash-dot patterns distinguish information routes. Dashed routes carry only L06 control bundles. Human decisions are information. Boundary branches retain their recorded meanings. IF-05 is retired.

book_visual_examples.principle: Enclose logical parts in the system frame. Connect boundary ports to named parts. Concern views may repeat a subset of the same parts.
External participants are separate from the system. Directed item flows cross explicit system ports.
Keep the stable logical decomposition and distinguish component responsibilities.
